brief:
Israel's caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called Wednesday for an immediate halt to his corruption trial after judges cast doubt on the charges, Al-Monitor reported. The court recommended dropping a case in which Netanyahu faces bribery accusations, according to the report.

Netanyahu seized on the judicial development to press for termination of the long-running proceedings against him. The recommendation to drop charges comes after years of legal battles that have run parallel to his political tenure.
dek: Israel's caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday called for an immediate end to his long-running corruption trial after judges cast doubt on the charges and recommended dropping a case in which he is accused of bribery.
title: Netanyahu demands trial end after judges question corruption charges
